name: otp-input
title: Otp Input
description: A one-time code typed into a row of single-character boxes: typing moves on, Backspace goes back, arrow keys move between boxes, a pasted or autofilled code fills them all, and the whole code is one value.

meta.when: A short code sent by message or shown by an app: sign-in, confirming an email or a phone. For a password use password-input; for any other short text use input.
meta.example: <OtpInput aria-label="Code from the message" length={6} onComplete={(code) => verify(code)} name="code" />
